- 2026-11-05 (I-054, not applied; decision I-055 for Brian): measured on `astro preview`, Lighthouse 13.5 mobile. `fetchpriority="low"` has no effect on an SVG `<image>` (Chrome keeps it Medium; `/book` 96, LCP 2.71 s either way). With no terrain request at all, `/book` is 100, LCP 1.51–1.66 s; zone pages are 97–98 (LCP 2.4–2.6 s) with it. A lazy `<img loading="lazy" fetchpriority="low">` in a `<foreignObject>` gets the same gain without JS and is identical in Chromium, but in WebKit (Safari's engine) the shading stops short of the map's left edge at the full view, so it was dropped. Re-encoding the WebP saves only 20–35%. The workable way left is JS (set `href` when the map shows or after load), which leaves JS-off visitors without terrain and adds a script to the zone pages: a §B4/§D change for Brian to decide.
